title: It's stuck, Dad — my jacket won't come off the hook.
scene: 出门前，孩子的夹克挂在门边高挂钩上拿不下来，拉链挂住了，孩子够不着挂钩看不清。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It's stuck, Dad — my jacket won't come off the hook.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I can't reach it — the hook is too high for me to see.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Here, let me lift you up so you can look.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Oh! The zipper is caught on the hook.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Lift the jacket up a little, and pull it off. There, it's free!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You're welcome. Zippers can be sneaky sometimes.
